children: WTI Midland differentials rose on Wednesday after Trafigura sold a cargo to Exxon.
Indications are free on board (FOB) unless marked as cost, insurance and freight (CIF) or delivered at place.
WTI Midland: Exxon bought from Trafigura for September 14-18 CIF Rotterdam at dated Brent plus $1.55. This equates to about dated Brent minus 18 cents FOB, Reuters calculations show.

WTI Midland: Petroineos bid for September 22-26 CIF Rotterdam at dated Brent plus $1.50 and for September 27 to October 2 CIF Rotterdam at dated Brent plus $1.90. The higher bid equates to about dated Brent plus 17 cents FOB, Reuters calculations show.
WTI Midland: Shell bid for September 14-30 CIF Rotterdam at dated Brent plus $1.10.
WTI Midland was offered at dated Brent plus $1.05 CIF in the previous session.
